meta.name: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things
meta.description: By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

videos.title: Chief Oji and Cute Things
videos.overview: A coworker discovers Mitsutaka's cute keychains. Mitsutaka visits a cat café but is met with a familiar face.

videos.title: Chief Oji and the Gacha Guy
videos.overview: Mitsutaka tries his hand at a gacha machine for Pugtaro merch, but he ends up being spotted by a young man.

videos.title: Chief Oji and His First Comrade
videos.overview: Mitsutaka goes shopping for merch with Kenta for the first time. Mitsutaka takes a business trip with Wataru.

videos.title: Chief Oji and Sweet Things
videos.overview: Mitsutaka visits a dessert buffet with his coworkers to eat cute cakes. Mitsutaka looks after a lost child.

videos.title: Chief Oji and the Home Drinking Party
videos.overview: Mitsutaka overhears a conversation at the bar. Kenta invites Mitsutaka over to his place for drinks.

videos.title: Chief Oji and His Nephew's Birthday
videos.overview: Mitsutaka takes a cooking class on Masumi's birthday. Wataru goes clothes shopping on his day off with Masumi.

videos.title: Chief Oji and the World of Dreams
videos.overview: Wataru buys a gift on his business trip. Mitsutaka goes to Kit D Land for the stage show he won tickets to.

videos.title: Chief Oji and the Class Reunion
videos.overview: Mitsutaka attends his middle school reunion and confronts his past trauma. Mitsutaka wears a mascot suit.
